subject: Post-demo: procurement & decision stakeholders — next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluewave.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & decision stakeholders — next steps

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the candid feedback from the team. Quick recap and asks so we can move toward a pilot: 

• Demo highlights: low-latency embedding pipeline + per-route cost controls seemed to map to your performance goals.
• Decision criteria you mentioned: predictable unit cost, SOC2 evidence, and a clear PO/invoice path tied to AP.

As discussed, can you confirm the following so we can prepare the mutual action plan (attached):
1) Economic buyer: who will sign off budget (name & title)?
2) Procurement contact: who owns vendor intake + expected lead time to approve a vendor?
3) Security checklist owner: who will be the point for SOC2 evidence and legal questions?
4) Invoicing rules: PO required, net terms, and billing email?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll share an updated mutual_action_plan.xlsx with dates tied to the items above (attached).
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min vendor-intake + security sync next week to walk procurement through the intake form.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluewave.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@bluewave.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & decision stakeholders — next steps

Thanks Mateo — great demo. Quick answers below and attaching our vendor intake so you can see the fields procurement expects.

1) Economic buyer: Elena Park (VP Product) — she owns the budget for experimentation initiatives.
2) Procurement contact: I looped in Procurement Ops (procurement@bluewave.com) on this thread; primary intake reviewer is Lydia Ho (Procurement Manager). Typical vendor intake is 7–10 business days once we have completed forms + insurance/W9.
3) Security checklist owner: Security & Compliance is led by Raj Patel (raj.patel@bluewave.com). He’ll be the reviewer for SOC2 artifacts.
4) Invoicing rules: PO is required. Standard is net-30. Invoices should be sent to billing@bluewave.com and include our PO number and a completed W9.

Attaching: bluewave_vendor_intake.pdf

Proposed: I can set a joint 30-min slot for next Wed with Lydia + Raj if that works — goal would be to clear intake questions and surface any legal redlines.

— Samantha
Samantha Reed
Director, Data Platforms | BlueWave Financial
samantha.reed@bluewave.com | +1 (617) 555-2199

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluewave.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@bluewave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & decision stakeholders — next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Samantha — that’s very helpful.

I’ll update the mutual_action_plan.xlsx to include:
- Elena Park (economic buyer) — target decision by 2027-02-01
- Lydia Ho (procurement) — vendor intake window 7–10 business days once form + W9 received
- Raj Patel (security) — SOC2 artifact review; request to have evidence shared by next Thursday if possible

Karthik — can you prepare a short packet with the SOC2 summary, our standard data handling FAQ, and a copy of our W9 (attached) so we can send this to Raj/Lydia in the same email? Also, any known redlines from legal that materially affect timelines?

Samantha — if next Wed works, please send a calendar invite and we’ll bring our PM and security lead to the call. I’ll also include a DocuSign link for the mutual action plan signature if that helps speed approvals.

Attachments: redwood_w9.pdf

Best,
Mateo

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@bluewave.com>

Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & decision stakeholders — next steps

Quick add from AP side: 
• Please make sure invoices include a PO number and are sent to billing@bluewave.com.
• Payment terms: net-30 from invoice date.
• For international vendors we require bank details + EIN; for U.S.-based vendors W9 is sufficient.
• If you need an expedited payment (rare), include a note in the invoice and cc procurement@bluewave.com.

I’ll share Lydia’s calendar in a follow-up to coordinate intake timing.

— Tom Nguyen
Accounts Payable Manager | BlueWave Financial
tom.nguyen@bluewave.com
